question: What voltage did sensor 4.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 02:10:16?
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: "4.0"})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T02:10:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.voltage AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
